question: Can all physical wave and memory sectors share a stable geometry in the declared reciprocal routing circuit and exact backgrounds?

method.action: SS OPS 1 H=(pi/2)|w dagger (a-b)|², lambda=0. Three onsite/bond pairs per cycle, two wave spinors and six independent memories per cell. Explicit new incidence; not the Test 3 reduced stencil.
method.units: ell=tau_c=1; q=k ell; omega tau_c; growth log modulus per cycle; event parameter is not proper time.
method.domain: Vacuum orthogonal memories, equal nonzero orthogonal memories, counterport collinear memories. Twenty physical real dimensions. 26 signed directions, four radii .02,.04,.08,.16; three 65-point full-zone paths.
method.boundaries: Homogeneous infinite-lattice Bloch matrices; local impulse for three cycles on 9³/13³ periodic boxes before wraparound. No continuum PDE discretization.
method.initial_data: Exact analytical physical period-one backgrounds a=b=0; a=b=(.5,0); a=-b=(.5,0). Counter memory representatives return in four cycles but projectors in one. PCG64 off-background gate controls.
method.solver: Exact reciprocal event solution; full physical Jacobians via centered h=2e-5,1e-5; independent DOP853 with rtol2e-12 atol2e-14 maxstep.05. Compose twenty-dimensional maps with bond Fourier phase. Save all eigenmodes in analysis.
method.tolerances: Conservation and physical recurrence <1e-10; differential/reference <2e-6; exponential growth fail above max(1e-5,5 matched eigenvalue refinement). Unit moduli leave stability unresolved.

hypotheses.prediction: Every physical sector shares a stable nondegenerate cone, possibly with a common drift and anisotropy; stationary physical memories plus propagating waves contradict this at the vacuum.
A signal sector can be geometric while memories have additional response. A successful explanation needs independent constitutive and clock predictions; spectra alone cannot establish it.
Equal nonzero waves still decouple memories; counterport waves activate memory response and may introduce growth or mode dependence.

controls.purpose: Verify complete differential map and conserved quantities
controls.method: Independent DOP853 local Jacobians, exact frozen vacuum Fourier reference, off-background local conservation.

controls.purpose: Distinguish gauge redundancy and real backreaction
controls.method: Memory phase null, physical overlap change, full/frozen maps on three exact backgrounds.
Two differential steps, four paired radii, two finite boxes, three-cycle local impulse and Fourier comparison.
